import math

def calculate_s(n, p, q):
    """Calculates S = (12 + n)/p + (13 - n)/q."""
    return (12 + n) / p + (13 - n) / q

# Test n = 1
n1 = 1
p_range = range(1, 6)
q_range = range(1, 6)

max_s_n1 = -float('inf')
best_p_n1 = None
best_q_n1 = None

for p in p_range:
    for q in q_range:
        s = calculate_s(n1, p, q)
        if s > max_s_n1:
            max_s_n1 = s
            best_p_n1 = p
            best_q_n1 = q

print(f"--- n = 1 ---")
print(f"Maximum S found: {max_s_n1}")
print(f"Corresponding p: {best_p_n1}, q: {best_q_n1}")

# Test n = 12
n12 = 12
max_s_n12 = -float('inf')
best_p_n12 = None
best_q_n12 = None

for p in p_range:
    for q in q_range:
        s = calculate_s(n12, p, q)
        if s > max_s_n12:
            max_s_n12 = s
            best_p_n12 = p
            best_q_n12 = q

print(f"\n--- n = 12 ---")
print(f"Maximum S found: {max_s_n12}")
print(f"Corresponding p: {best_p_n12}, q: {best_q_n12}")

import math

max_S = -float('inf')
best_triplet = None

# Iterate n from 1 to 12
for n in range(1, 13):
    # Iterate q starting from q_min = 14 - n up to 20
    q_min = 14 - n
    
    # Ensure q_min is at least 1, although for n <= 13, q_min >= 1.
    # For n=13, q_min=1, but n only goes up to 12.
    
    # We iterate q up to 20 as specified in the task
    for q in range(q_min, 21):
        
        # Calculate RHS: 1 - (13 - n)/q
        # We already know RHS > 0 since q >= 14 - n
        RHS = 1 - (13 - n) / q
        
        # Calculate the lower bound for p: p > (12 + n) / RHS
        p_lower_bound = (12 + n) / RHS
        
        # Calculate the minimum required integer p: p_min = floor(p_lower_bound) + 1
        p_min = math.floor(p_lower_bound) + 1
        
        # Since p must be a positive integer, and p_lower_bound is positive 
        # (because 12+n > 0 and RHS > 0), p_min will be at least 1.
        
        # Calculate S using p_min
        S = (12 + n) / p_min + (13 - n) / q
        
        # Check constraint (although p_min calculation guarantees S < 1)
        # We check it just to be safe regarding floating point precision
        if S >= 1.0:
            # This should ideally not happen if math.floor was perfect, 
            # but if it does, we skip this triplet as it violates S < 1
            continue 
        
        # Record if S is the maximum found so far
        if S > max_S:
            max_S = S
            best_triplet = (n, p_min, q)

print(f"Maximum S found: {max_S}")
print(f"Corresponding triplet (n, p, q): {best_triplet}")
